blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The southwest monsoon, or habagat, will continue to affect Southern Luzon and Visayas, while generally fair weather with occasional rains may prevail over Metro Manila on Sunday, Sept. 20, the state weather bureau said. Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) weather specialist Daniel Villamil said in its 5 p.m. weather advisory that the southwest monsoon will affect the western portions of Southern Luzon and Visayas within the next three to five days.
